'''Consul''' was a title denoting a position that sat alongside [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassadors]], [[Politics/Legends|politicians]], and members of [[Monarchy/Legends|royalty]]. They often had [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droids]] serving them as personal attachés.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>

After the fall of the [[Eternal Empire]] the planet of [[Zakuul]] would be ruled by a Consul. Consul was also the title given to [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassadors]] by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]], the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], and [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]. Within the Trade Federation, the title also meant the holder of it represented a planet belonging to the group. It was also a rank among the [[Intendant caste]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. They were often in charge of resource requisition, and other [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucratic]] matters. They also functioned as the servants of [[Prefect/Legends|Prefects]].
